Event Description

Love and language – two forces that shape our world. Language is more than words. Love is more than emotion. They are the stories we tell, the songs we sing, the bridges we build.

Through poetry, performance, and storytelling, we honour the past, embrace the present, and dream of a future where all voices are heard.

This is not just an event. This is a movement. A celebration. A revolution of love and language.

Join us. Speak. Feel. Belong.
